record.question: Which one of the following is an input device in a computer?
record.explanation: Answer A: Keyboard. A keyboard is the conventional human-input peripheral. IBM’s own command documentation explicitly identifies keyboard as the standard input device. The pen drive is classified as storage, OS as software and cable as a connection medium. Historical/source note: Basic hardware-device classification; a storage device can carry input data but is not thereby the intended human-input peripheral. Reference: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/ibm-mq/10.0.x?topic=commands-mqsc-input-file-syntax. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
